messages:
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled in ~5m for service=llm-router image=redwood/llm-router:v3.1.0. Planned flag change: llm_prefetch_ramp -> 5% -> 20% over 45m with per-pod stagger=8s. Change window 23:30-02:30 UTC. @rachel @nate

rachel: quick heads-up  staging replay showed a p99 token tail +16% on low-memory nodes. hold ramp until QA checks cold-start traces.

nate: can we keep flag at 0% for canaries and apply a prefetch tweak? prefer preflight in shadow then tiny live soak.

deploy-bot: Current state: queued; default flags 0% for canaries unless manually set.

ops-ash: set llm_prefetch_ramp=0% for canaries and paused automated increments. Note: "hold - investigate p99 on low-memory nodes" :pause_button:

qa-anya: running focused cold-start suite with full traces against v3.1.0. collecting KV warmup timing and per-pod memory stats. ETA ~10m.

rachel: thanks. if warmup lag confirmed, plan is: 1) inject prefetch=3 per replica on startup 2) increase stagger to 12s for small pods 3) re-run staging. rollback plan = pin to v3.0.9.

qa-anya: replay done  5/150 traces show cold-start tails aligned with <2GB pods; KV populate delayed ~7s. attaching trace ids.

nate: OK. I'll prepare rollout override: prefetch=3, stagger-map for small pods=12s, kv-seed=10s. pushing to staging now.

ops-ash: added safety gate: abort if p99 > baseline +10% for 10m or error-rate >0.4%. Override applied to staging. Canary remains paused pending manual resume. PM notified.

pm-zoe: posting release-note snippet for PM: "Canary delayed: v3.1.0 ramp paused for warmup tuning on low-memory pods; mitigation plan in progress. No customer impact."

rachel: re-run staging with overrides scheduled, will post results in ~12m. if good, we do conservative ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20% with manual approvals.

qa-anya: re-run results: cold-start tails reduced to within baseline +/-3% after overrides. recommend manual live soak: 1% for 20m, then 5% for 60m.

nate: rollback/pin snippet if needed:
```
redwoodctl route pin --service llm-router --version v3.0.9 --reason "canary cold-start regression"
redwoodctl deploy abort --id 4280000000
```

ops-ash: manual resume initiated by ops-ash: set llm_prefetch_ramp=1% for canaries. monitoring dashboards pinned to p99 by pod-size. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Resume recorded. Canary progressing: soak 1% started. Automated increments disabled. Aborts will run pin + abort commands.

rachel: monitoring first 20m. if stable, ops-ash please advance to 5% and keep safety gate active.

qa-anya: first 20m stable, no error-rate change, p99 within +2% on small pods. green to advance.

ops-ash: advancing to 5% now. safety gate live. Support alerted.

nate: thanks team. will keep thread open until final roll-forward or rollback. post anomalies here. :thumbsup:
